Date : 12.08.2024

Heard Mr. M. Day, learned counsel for the appellants.
This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the appellants/claimants for enhancement of the compensation which was awarded to them by the impugned judgment and award dated 24.04.2024 passed by the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No. II, Kamrup(M), Guwahati in MAC Case No. 414/2021.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Call for the case record of MAC Case No. 414/2021 from the concerned Tribunal.

The appellants shall take steps for issuance of notice to the respondents by registered post with A/D as well as by usual mode within seven days from the date of this order, returnable after four weeks.
